top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs reversible-terminator sequencing-by-synthesis (Balasubramanian, Klenerman), the most independently reproduced and defined nucleotide chemistry on the list, with base editing (Liu), a defined deamination chemistry with first clinical use; reading and rewriting DNA fit one prize within three names. P002 is my fallback if the committee prefers one topic, since it keeps the most mature achievement. P001 ranks third: the science is strong and independently validated, but attribution among Crews, Deshaies, Handa and Ciulli, and the unsettled PROTAC clinical record, leave it less settled. P004 follows because the in vivo physical state of condensates and the link to function remain contested. No award is last because every proposal recognises substantive, reproduced work.
